title: Restart Chromium under the kiosk user service

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done_for_prod.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done_for_prod.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-012 RED: no managed user-service recovery proof exists; GREEN: with central HTTPS reachable, terminating Chromium/client in advertising, active and synthetic result-holding states causes automatic process replacement/reload as display, returns to advertising, retains the manually configured central display credential plus camera/quality/sensor settings, and discards prior personalized result, reference frames, QR/session token and active Attempt; decisive comparison: pre/post profile/state probes and redacted service output distinguish retained kiosk configuration from discarded personalized state; artifact: reports and Playwright transcripts under .tasks/TASK-054-T3-FT-003-W5/.

success_outcome: The user service automatically restores usable advertising after browser failure without losing the central credential or reviving participant state.
anti_goals: Do not promise offline start when the origin is unreachable.
Do not rotate/reveal credentials or restore personalized state.
Do not own kiosk sandbox policy or execute the recovery runbook.

forbidden_scope: Central runtime check owned by TASK-051-T3-FT-003-W4

constraints: Use the source-managed display-user systemd unit with Restart=always and sandbox intact.

Managed central display credential survives; personalized QR/session/Attempt/frame state does not.
Recovery replays no search and mutates no server credential/serving state.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-012 process replacement/reload in named states.
Retained managed configuration versus discarded personalized-state comparison.
